0.original: Lyngsath wants to assign you your first task.

1.original: Lyngsath bids you prepare a pot of maple syrup using the skillet he has given you. The recipe calls for maple sap, which can be had from Jossy of the Culinarians' Guild.

2.original: Lyngsath is pleased with your maple syrup, declaring that it far surpasses his expectations for a novice. The guildmaster encourages you to keep working at your cooking skills, and bids you return again when you are ready for your next task.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The next culinarian quest will be available from Lyngsath upon reaching level 5.

24.original: Deliver a pot of maple syrup to Lyngsath.

48.original: I see yer 'oldin' the skillet the right way 'round. Good!

49.original: A culinarian lives an' dies by 'is utensils. Get that into yer 'ead afore ye do aught else, or yer food'll look like shite, an' taste worse.

50.original: Now, let's see what ye can do.

51.original: For starters, I want ye to make me maple syrup usin' yer skillet.

52.original: Recipe's as simple as they come. Ye only need two things: maple sap an' a fire shard.

53.original: Jossy sells sap over at the guild counter.

54.original: Now, time's a-wastin', so get to work! It don't pay to keep folk waitin' in our trade!

55.original: Guildmaster Lyngsath has tasked you with synthesizing a pot of maple syrup.

56.original: To commence, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Logs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Crafting Log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

57.original: What in the seven 'ells are ye waitin' for? I told ye to make me maple syrup, didn't I!?

58.original: The maple syrup's ready, is it? About bloody time! Let's see 'ow it tastes, then...

59.original: Oho, this ain't bad! Flavor's all right, consistency's...nearly there. In short, a damn sight better'n a lot o' novices manage.

60.original: As ye prob'ly know, maple syrup's one o' the most popular sweet'ners around, an' a key ingredient in all manner o' cakes an' treats.

61.original: What ye prob'ly <hex:021A020203>didn't<hex:021A020103> know is that boilin' the stuff down gets ye maple sugar, a different sweet'ner with different uses.

62.original: Jus' goes to show, even the simplest ingredients can 'ave 'idden complexities.

63.original: I said earlier that a culinarian lives an' dies by 'is utensils. Well, that's just the 'alf of it.

64.original: 'E also needs to know 'is ingredients─an' <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> summat as only comes with experience.

65.original: Keep yer nose to the stove, an' report back when yer ripe fer another task.

66.original: The next culinarian quest will be available from Lyngsath upon reaching level 5.
